tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Ali wants to talk about new school club. which club to choose. what to bring. when it meets.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Ali.

promptBlocks.subject: Join a club
paragraphs: I am writing about new school club. which club to choose? what to bring?
when it meets? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Ali and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: new school club
ketImageBrief.panel1: Ali starts new school club with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Ali solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
